plugins.name: designer-pro-and-seo
plugins.description: Web design + SEO + build-workflow skills: design-system generation and on-brand page rendering, design tokens, build briefs, pre-delivery QA, portable-HTML porting for any CMS, and a full SEO suite covering technical, schema, sitemap, content, GEO, hreflang, drift, local, and e-commerce.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: A version-controlled project context architecture. Keeps project memory accurate, minimal, retrievable, and evidence-backed across fresh sessions, context resets, branches, and worktrees. Six modes, a deterministic Node core, two lightweight hooks, a path-scoped writing rule, and an audit that runs on an external model so memory is never graded by the context that wrote it.
